name: College of the Canyons Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes on your own school campus during the school day. High school students can earn credit toward a certificate, an associate degree or transfer.
who_can_apply: You must be in grades 7 to 12 at a partner school. Schools include Bowman, Canyon, Castaic, Hart, Saugus and Valencia High. The page lists more.
pay_detail: No cost. You save on tuition and textbooks.
deadline_text: No dates or enrollment steps are listed as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Email earlycollege@canyons.edu. Allow up to 72 hours for a reply.
notes: Grades 7 and 8 take noncredit classes only. Letter grades in credit classes count toward your GPA at both your high school and the college.
